pageTitle: "Fantastical Evening Star" Layla (Cryo) Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise~
name: "Fantastical Evening Star" Layla (Cryo) Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise~
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Today, we will be introducing Layla, a student from the Rtawahist Darshan! The Rtawahist Darshan of the six Darshans under the Sumeru Akademiya is dedicated to the study of Illuminationism. Layla can be found among the researchers of Illuminationism, which is centered around astrology and astronomy, learning of the cosmos that has clutched the world in its embrace since time immemorial. Layla draws star charts tirelessly in order to write her thesis. Due to her teachers' high expectations, her desk is always stacked with a mountain of papers that never seems to decrease no matter how hard she tries. Layla's academic career has put her under a lot of pressure. Do you have any relaxation tips to share with her?
